crossRefs.note: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions…
I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…
I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from Yahweh.”
Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of…
God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by…
Yahweh, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, Yahweh. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In…

translations.web: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
translations.bsb: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
translations.kjv: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
translations.asv: And I said, This is my infirmity; But I will remember the years of the right hand of the Most High.
